regressions.what: Example 2 now identifies the one sunset pick as requested_model/requested_model_id = "openai/gpt-5.2-codex" (9871, 9894) and alternatives[0].model_id = "gpt-5.2-codex" (9886). Before this change both strings were "gpt-5.2-codex". The alternative is the same rejected pick and its provider_id = "codex" identifies the runtime route. Use "openai/gpt-5.2-codex" in the alternative model_id too, preserving the vendor-qualified identity required by §1.1 and the separate runtime route in §1.2.

The new substitution_reason? rule (9825) requires omission when fallback follows no_eligible_candidate, a fallback path that Step 4 explicitly permits (10039). The adjacent clamp_reason? rule (9824) still says “a model fallback is `fallback_used = true`, its `model_substituted` code is `substitution_reason`”. Those field rules prescribe opposite outcomes for that path. Apply the requested-model replacement condition to the clamp row’s cross-reference as well and keep the no-winner fallback flag independent of substitution.
